category_edits.rationale: Jointly increase embedding/GRU width to 192, raise dropout to 0.2, and reduce Adam learning rate to 7e-4 across all four datasets. Extra capacity may distinguish heterogeneous interests, while stronger regularization and smaller updates constrain overfitting. Existing checkpoint metadata and predictor loading propagate the width consistently. Preserve the current readout, tied embeddings, loss, single-model routing, and training limits.

change_summary: Tune shared GRU4Rec defaults to width 192, dropout 0.2, and Adam learning rate 0.0007. Existing metadata keeps predictor and checkpoint shapes consistent.
